items.rationale: Like-for-like fittings for the failed indoor heating pipe are covered under 2.4.3 and 7.1.7(c). Four at €10.50 total €42 gross.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers the separately specified repair fittings; the different model number does not establish a duplicate charge. Four at €10.50 total €42 gross.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers like-for-like repair fittings. The gross estimate for all five is €104.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers these repair fittings. The gross estimate for all five is €103.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers like-for-like repair fittings. The single elbow is estimated at €21 gross.
Section 7.1.7(c) expressly covers repair fasteners. Eight at about €1.16 total approximately €9.30 gross.
The clamps are covered repair fixings under 7.1.7(c). Four at €4.80 total €19.20 gross.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers the fixings. Using the nearby clamp sizes as a benchmark, four at €5.25 total €21 gross.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers customary repair labour. All 6.75 invoiced hours at about €93.33 total €630 gross.
The claim confirms a helper attended, and 7.1.7(g) covers that repair labour. All 5.75 hours at about €71 total approximately €409 gross.
Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.7(c) cover like-for-like replacement of the failed heating pipe. The 6.4 m invoiced at about €15.40 per metre total approximately €99 gross.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge on this contractor's invoice. One charge is estimated at €82 gross.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers consumables used in the repair. The single flat rate is estimated at €43 gross.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes administrative and processing fees billed on top of labour and materials. The €25 estimate is conditional only.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers reinstatement of the original pipe insulation. The gross estimate for the full 6 m is €135.

Section 7.1.7(c) covers separately installed insulation, but 7.1.8(c) bars a second charge for the same insulation and no distinct use is documented. If the mats were separate, six at €20 would total €120 gross.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers wire used to secure the reinstated insulation. Two at €13 total €26 gross.
The reported day and a half supports treating this as a separate block of repair labour under 7.1.7(g), not a repeat of line 9. Seven hours at about €93.15 total approximately €652 gross.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows only the first travel charge for this contractor's repair invoice. The €82 figure is the conditional gross rate for one charge.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes the contractor's protective equipment, including gloves. The conditional estimate for one kit is €25 gross.
Sections 5.2.1 and 7.1.7(a) cover disposal of material removed during the insured repair. The single flat rate is estimated at €60 gross.

Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.8(a) do not cover a bundled hygiene and coating charge without evidence that the treatment was needed to repair physical tile damage. If the whole line qualified, five hours at €55 would total €275 gross.
